items.summary: OpenZeppelin and Chainlink unite the development standard behind $38T in value transferred with Chainlink's oracle, compliance, and cross-chain infrastructure. CCIP and ACE now native in OpenZeppelin tooling.

items.title: 🏴 The CFTC Isn't Waiting on Congress
items.summary: CFTC Chairman Mike Selig wants federal rules for crypto exchanges, retail margin, and prediction markets. Here's what he told Bankless.

items.title: The CFTC's Proposed Rules to Reshape U.S. Crypto Markets
items.summary: Chairman Selig's CTX and CAM proposals could bring retail margin onshore, put exchanges under one federal roof, and reshape the fight over prediction markets.
